description: Detect and execute volume moves to balance server load

admin_config_form.title: Volume Balance Admin Config
admin_config_form.description: Admin-side controls for volume balance detection scope.

sections.title: Scope
sections.description: Optional filters applied before balance detection.

fields.name: collection_filter
fields.label: Collection Filter
fields.description: Filter collections for balance detection. Use ALL_COLLECTIONS (default) to treat all volumes as one pool, EACH_COLLECTION to run detection separately per collection, or a comma-separated list of names, wildcards, or regex patterns.

fields.name: volume_state
fields.label: Volume State Filter
fields.description: Filter volumes by state: ALL (default), ACTIVE (writable volumes below size limit), or FULL (read-only volumes above size limit).

fields.name: data_center_filter
fields.label: Data Center Filter
fields.description: Only balance volumes in matching data centers (comma-separated, wildcards supported). Leave empty for all.

fields.name: rack_filter
fields.label: Rack Filter
fields.description: Only balance volumes on matching racks (comma-separated, wildcards supported). Leave empty for all.

fields.name: node_filter
fields.label: Node Filter
fields.description: Only balance volumes on matching nodes (comma-separated, wildcards supported). Leave empty for all.

sections.title: Detection Thresholds
sections.description: Controls for when balance jobs should be proposed.

fields.name: imbalance_threshold
fields.label: Imbalance Threshold
fields.description: Detect when skew exceeds this ratio.

fields.name: min_server_count
fields.label: Minimum Server Count
fields.description: Require at least this many servers for balancing.

fields.name: io_byte_per_second
fields.label: Move IO Limit (bytes/sec)
fields.description: Limit each volume move's copy's rate in bytes per second. 0 falls back to each volume server's own maintenance rate.

sections.title: Batch Execution
sections.description: Controls for running multiple volume moves per job. The worker coordinates moves via gRPC and is not on the data path.

fields.name: max_concurrent_moves
fields.label: Max Concurrent Moves
fields.description: Maximum number of volume moves to run concurrently within a single batch job.

fields.name: batch_size
fields.label: Batch Size
fields.description: Maximum number of volume moves to group into a single job. Set to 1 to disable batching.
